name: Sculpfun S40 MAX 48W
tagline: 2025 large-format Sculpfun — 830×800 mm bed and 48W compressed diode
tldr: The S40 MAX (2025) targets makers who outgrew 400 mm frames: 830×800 mm work area, 48W optical power, auto-focus, and Wi-Fi via TS1 screen. Built for sign panels and batch cutting — verify shipping weight and workshop space before ordering.
mainObjective: Extra-large Sculpfun diode for big panels and production-style cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Massive work area for diode class
Strong value vs CO₂ for large wood
beginnerNotes: Only buy if you regularly hit size limits on S30 Ultra or 400 mm machines. First laser buyers should start smaller.
proTips: Use Z-axis offset per pass in LightBurn for flatter thick cuts. Budget 50L+ air assist for claimed one-pass thick cuts.
primaryUse: 2025 large-area Sculpfun for engraving and cutting oversized wood, leather, and acrylic panels.
